title: Responsive Navigation Bars
subtopics: Testing menus on touch and keyboard devices
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of responsive navigation bars and when it is appropriate.
Apply navbar expansion breakpoints using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check collapsible navigation content and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study responsive navigation bars and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Responsive Navigation Bars helps people understand where they are and how to reveal related content. Use the right semantic element, visible active/current state, and keyboard/touch checks at multiple widths.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating responsive navigation bars as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
